page: Microsoft Azure ND96asr_v4 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the NDASv4_A100 family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 900.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 9.38 GB of RAM per core.

This server integrates eight GPUs and includes 10,650 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is Premium Storage capable and supports Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) networking. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Positioned in the high-end GPU-accelerated hardware class, this server offers dense resource allocation for workloads requiring massive parallel processing and high-speed local storage. Appropriate workloads include large-scale deep learning, GPU-accelerated databases, high-performance computing, and complex simulation tasks.
